data.long_meaning: The name Bohlen is derived from the Old German word 'bald' meaning 'bold' and 'hil' meaning 'warrior'. This name was given to babies born into noble families or to those who showed great courage in battle. The name Bohlen carries the meaning “Bold warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bohlen usually hope their child will grow to embody bold warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Bohlen as a name embodies the ancient Germanic tradition of naming children based on their characteristics or the born environment. In battle times, a name like Bohlen represented bravery and strength, which would encourage the child to live up to the expectations of his name. This cultural tradition has been carried on, and even in modern times, families with a history of valor often choose names with meaning related to warrior and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: As a spiritual significance, the name Bohlen means being bold in one's faith and standing strong in following the Christian values. The name suggests courage, resilience, and an unyielding spirit, which aligns well with the Christian principles of keeping faith in tough times and staying steadfast to one's beliefs. Being a Bohlen carries the spiritual weight of upholding these virtues throughout one's life.
